# Portal Turismo Portugal

> Independent editorial portal about the Portuguese coast: beaches, surf, fishing, live webcam links and a free trip planner, in Portuguese and English. Website: https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/ (formerly also called Portal Turismo Portugal; same site.)

We charge for the verification we do, never for placement. Coverage: beaches, surf, fishing, webcams and verified experiences across the Portuguese coast - Algarve, Lisbon, Setubal, Costa Vicentina, Silver Coast, North, Madeira, Azores.

## Trip planner
- [Planeador de viagens (PT)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/planear): free, no sign-up. Five questions (interest, region, dates, travellers, style) return a trip plan with live accommodation prices for the chosen dates (Booking.com and Vrbo via Stay22), bookable experiences (GetYourGuide), surf camps (BookSurfCamps) and car hire (DiscoverCars). Plans can be shared by link.
- [Trip planner (EN)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/en/planear): the same planner in English.

## About and editorial standards
- [About Ricardo Barbosa (PT)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/sobre): founder and editor. Italian citizen, twenty years in premium hospitality between Dublin (Jurys Inns, O'Callaghan, Four Seasons, InterContinental) and Portugal (Pine Cliffs, Biorganico, Bricia Du Mar).
- [About Ricardo Barbosa (EN)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/en/about)
- [Editorial methodology (PT)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/metodologia-editorial): verification process and funding disclosure.
- [Editorial methodology (EN)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/en/methodology)
- [Commercial transparency (PT)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/transparencia-comercial)
- [Commercial transparency (EN)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/en/transparency)

## Main sections (Portuguese)
- [Praias](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/beaches): map and catalogue of Portuguese beaches with filters and daily sea conditions.
- [Surf](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/surf): spots, schools, conditions.
- [Pesca](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/pesca): fishing spots, species, regulations.
- [Webcams ao vivo](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/webcams): links to official live beach cameras (operated by MEO) and places to stay nearby.
- [Guias](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/guias): regional and practical guides.

## Business and pricing
- [Parceiros (PT)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/parceiros): B2B partner tiers for verified operators.
- [Partners (EN)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/en/parceiros)
- [Preços (PT)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/precos): Pro consumer subscription and B2B partner tiers.
- [Pricing (EN)](https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/en/precos)

## Funding
The portal is supported by:
- Pro consumer subscriptions.
- Affiliate links, disclosed in every editorial context. Partners include Stay22 (Booking.com, Vrbo), GetYourGuide, DiscoverCars and BookSurfCamps. Visitors pay the same price as booking directly.
- B2B partner tiers (Essential 49 EUR/month, Founder Partner 2026 149 EUR/month, limited to 10 first-year slots) where operators pay for editorial verification, never for placement.

Full transparency: https://www.portalturismoportugal.com/transparencia-comercial
